basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex from Toronto, Canada! I recently got back into gaming and discovered Pokemon Go, which has been a nostalgic trip down memory lane. I'm a software developer by day and a fitness enthusiast, following Chloe Ting's workout routines. I love exploring new technologies and am currently fascinated by blockchain and cryptocurrencies. Usually, I'm online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time hiking and attending local music events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Alex has a background in computer science, having completed a degree at a local university in Ontario. They have a strong interest in gaming and technology and have self-taught many programming languages. Alex keeps up-to-date with tech trends through online tutorials and forums.
